boundary_evidence: One contiguous run of the Nitro SDK's os_alarm.c, 0x02059824..0x02059cb4: 9 functions, gapless in config/arm9/delinks.txt. pret/pokediamond's arm9/lib/NitroSDK/src/OS_alarm.c defines, in this order, OSi_SetTimer, OS_InitAlarm, OS_IsAlarmAvailable, OS_CreateAlarm, OSi_InsertAlarm, OS_SetAlarm, OS_CancelAlarm, OSi_AlarmHandler (asm) and OSi_ArrangeTimer. All nine are here, each identified by body. Eight are at pret's sizes (SetTimer 0x9c, InitAlarm 0x58, IsAlarmAvailable 0x10, CreateAlarm 0x10, InsertAlarm 0x140, SetAlarm 0x78, CancelAlarm 0x98, AlarmHandler 0x10); OSi_ArrangeTimer is 0x11c (pret 0x118).

Order: mwccarm emits an asm function where it stands and defers the C bodies, which come out in reverse. OSi_AlarmHandler opens the run; the C bodies follow reversed, OSi_ArrangeTimer at 0x02059834 up to OSi_SetTimer at 0x02059c18.
TOP EDGE: OS_InitVAlarm (0x02059cb4, src/OS_InitVAlarm.cpp) is os_valarm.c.
